title: add-token-deposited-heatmap-and-alert-suppression-gates
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a token-cohort heatmap dashboard, a prioritized log needle sampler, and alert suppression gates to reduce noisy long-tail SLOs and improve operator signal-to-noise.
commits: feat(observability): token cohort indexer and heatmap metrics (Maya Chen)
chore(dashboard): add token-deposited heatmap panels and fixtures (Maya Chen)
feat(alerting): suppression gates and cohort-priority evaluator (Maya Chen)
fix(tests): stabilize sampler tests and linting (Maya Chen)
description:
Context and motivation:
We see persistent noisy alerts tied to the long tail of token-level cost/latency variance for multi-stage invocations (short prompts hitting large KV cache misses and long prompts with bursty token emission). Existing per-route SLOs fire frequently on low-importance cohorts, increasing oncall load and masking real regressions.

Goal:
1) Provide an operator-facing heatmap that surfaces cohorted token-level cost and 95/99 latency bands across (prompt_length, model_variant) slices.
2) Reduce alert noise by gating SLO alerts with cohort-level suppression rules (min-sample, quiet-windows, priority overrides).
3) Surface a prioritized log needle sample for high-impact cohorts so triage has immediate context (compact log excerpts + span anchors).

What this PR changes (high level):
- Introduces a token_cohort_indexer that buckets invocations into variable-width cohorts using a kurtosis-aware binning heuristic; emits three new metric series: token.deposited.count, token.deposited.cost_cents, token.phase.latency_ms with cohort tags.
- Adds a new dashboard (observability/dashboards/token_deposited_heatmap.json) with cohort heatmap, cohort timeline sparklines, and cohort-ranked anomaly table.
- Adds alert suppression gates under alerting/suppression/gates.go. Gates implement: min-sample threshold, rolling quiet-window backoff per-cohort, and a priority preemption flag used by the SLO alerting pipeline.
- Implements a compact "needle_sampler" that extracts K representative logs/spans per-cohort prioritized by cost*latency impact and uniqueness score; these are surfaced as compact runbook excerpts alongside alerts.
- Adds docs and a short runbook describing how to interpret heatmap, promote cohorts to higher priority, and tune suppression parameters.

Implementation notes and tradeoffs:
- Cohortization uses a kurtosis-weighted split to avoid overly fine buckets for heavy-tailed prompt length distributions. This keeps cardinality controlled while preserving long-tail resolution.
- Metrics are emitted at a 1m aggregation resolution to balance fidelity and cardinality. We intentionally do not emit per-token metrics at 1s resolution to avoid billing/ingest blowup for high-volume tenants.
- Suppression gates are conservative by default: min-sample = 30 (1m bins) and quiet-window starts at 15m on first suppression. Teams can override via config.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for token_cohort_indexer and needle_sampler included.
- Added dashboard fixture for manual QA.
- CI initially failed lint on gates.go due to import ordering; fixed in second commit. Flaky test token_cohort_indexer_test.go flaked in CI run #2; added deterministic seeding and retried. Final CI status: all checks passing.

Files changed (high level snippets):
- telemetry/metrics/token_cohort_indexer.go: adds indexer + comment describing binning heuristic (≈220 LOC).
- alerting/suppression/gates.go: new gate evaluator and unit tests (≈140 LOC).
- observability/dashboards/token_deposited_heatmap.json: dashboard panels with heatmap config and cohort table.
- observability/sampler/needle_sampler.go: deterministic sampler with export hooks.

Review conversation summary:
- Diego: "Overall this looks great; I like the kurtosis approach. Two asks: (1) document the cardinality bounds and expected metric cardinality per tenant, and (2) add a small opt-out for very high-volume customers."
- Maya (author): "Added cardinality section to docs and an env-config OPT_OUT_TOKEN_COHORT = true that bypasses cohort emitter. See docs/observability/token-cohort.md"
- Priya: "Can we make the quiet-window configurable per-tenant?"
- Maya: "Quiet-window is plumbed via config and defaults in infra; added test coverage for per-tenant override."
